title: Understanding Alternative Investment Fund (AIF) & their types
description:
Are you looking for investment opportunities beyond stocks, bonds, and mutual funds? Alternative Investment Funds or AIFs might be just what you need! In this video, we'll explain what AIFs are, how they work, and the different types of AIFs available in the market.

Join us as we explore the world of AIFs and learn how they can help you diversify your investment portfolio. We'll discuss the benefits and risks of investing in AIFs and provide examples of popular AIF types, including hedge funds, private equity funds, and real estate funds.

If you're interested in exploring new investment options and want to learn more about AIFs, this video is for you! Don't miss out on this opportunity to expand your investment knowledge and potentially increase your returns. Hit play and let's get started

00:13 Alternative Investment Fund
01:25 What are Alternative Investment Funds?
05:26 Types of AIF’s
05:47  Category I AIF
09:20 Category III AIF
13:28 Category II AIF
14:34 What are Fixed Income AIFs?

18:37 Conclusion
